Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for VNIT Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for VNIT Project Assistant (PA) recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 02 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Assistant (PA) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant (PA) position at VNIT.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant (PA) role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Arch. / B. Plan / B. Tech. (Planning) or a Master's in Geoinformatics with specific minimum percentages/CGPA and English proficiency.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant (PA) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant (PA) post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for VNIT Project Assistant (PA) recruitment going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology (VNIT), Nagpur, Maharashtra, 440010.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit specified for the Project Assistant (PA) post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for this position.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Project Assistant (PA) recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this Project Assistant (PA) position is contractual.
